sources.terms_clause: Terms of Use: 'No Content, including without limitation the website design and layout, graphics, images, hyperlinks and information, ... may be reproduced, republished, uploaded, posted, transmitted or distributed in any way ... without the prior written permission of MAS', 'except that you may download one copy of any information provided in this Web Site onto a single computer ... for your own personal non-commercial use'; and 'Except as set forth below, caching and links to, and the framing of this Web Site or any of the Contents are prohibited.'
sources.note: MAS's Open Data Licence and API terms allow commercial use, but they cover MAS datasets and the API, not the website's statements. The statements are Content under the site terms. Unblocks only with MAS's written permission recorded here.
